meta.name: Sample rewrites
meta.author: Sample Author[https://example.com/author]
meta.argumentsDesc:
Region: the feed's region
Feed: rewrite the feed

url-rewrite.49: UrlRewriteDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/a\\.test\\/old", head: None, replacement: "https://a.test/new", action: Redirect302 }
url-rewrite.50: UrlRewriteDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/a\\.test\\/moved", head: None, replacement: "https://a.test/new", action: Redirect307 }
url-rewrite.51: UrlRewriteDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/promo", head: None, replacement: "", action: Reject }
url-rewrite.52: UrlRewriteDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/banner", head: None, replacement: "", action: RejectDict }
url-rewrite.53: UrlRewriteDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/splash", head: None, replacement: "", action: RejectImg }
url-rewrite.54: UrlRewriteDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/link\\.a\\.test\\/\\?target=(.*)", head: None, replacement: "$1", action: Redirect302 }
url-rewrite.55: UrlRewriteDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v2", head: None, replacement: "https://api.b.test/v2", action: Header }

header-rewrite.58: HeaderRewriteDef { response: false, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, edit: Add("x-sample", "1") }
header-rewrite.59: HeaderRewriteDef { response: false, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, edit: Del("cookie") }
header-rewrite.60: HeaderRewriteDef { response: false, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, edit: Replace("user-agent", "Sample/1.0") }
header-rewrite.61: HeaderRewriteDef { response: true, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, edit: ReplaceRegex("set-cookie", "(a)=1", "$1=2") }

body-rewrite.65: BodyRewriteDef { response: true, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/feed", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, action: Replace([("\"promo\":true", "\"promo\":false")]) }
body-rewrite.66: BodyRewriteDef { response: true, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/list", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, action: Replace([("\"items\":\\[.+\\]", "\"items\":[]")]) }
body-rewrite.67: BodyRewriteDef { response: false, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/post", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, action: Replace([("\"debug\":true", "\"debug\":false")]) }
body-rewrite.68: BodyRewriteDef { response: true, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/feed", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, action: Jq("del(.data.promo)") }
body-rewrite.69: BodyRewriteDef { response: true, pattern: "^http:\\/\\/[^?]+\\/resolve\\?host=(?:api|cdn)\\.a\\.test", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, action: Jq(".dns[]? |= (.ips = [] | .ttl = 86400)") }
body-rewrite.70: BodyRewriteDef { response: false, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/post", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, action: Jq(".client.debug = false") }
body-rewrite.71: BodyRewriteDef { response: true, pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/tabs", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, action: Jq("jq-path=\"https://cdn.example.com/tabs.jq\"") }

map-local.74: MapLocalDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/empty", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, body: Text, data: "{}", status: 200, header: {"content-type": "application/json"}, content_type: "text/plain; charset=utf-8", request: false }
map-local.75: MapLocalDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/blank", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, body: File { base64: false }, data: "https://cdn.example.com/blank.json", status: 200, header: {}, content_type: "application/json", request: false }
map-local.76: MapLocalDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/pixel", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, body: Base64([71, 73, 70, 56, 57, 97, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 44]), data: "R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACw=", status: 200, header: {"content-type": "image/gif"}, content_type: "application/octet-stream", request: false }
map-local.77: MapLocalDef { pattern: "^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/gone", conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, body: TinyGif, data: "", status: 404, header: {}, content_type: "image/gif", request: false }

script.81: ScriptDef { name: "sample.response", path: "https://cdn.example.com/response.js", kind: HttpResponse, pattern: Some("^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/(feed|list)\\?"), conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: true, binary_body: false, full_header: false, max_size: 0, cronexp: "", event: "", timeout: None, argument: Some(String("region=US&feed=true")) }
script.82: ScriptDef { name: "sample.request", path: "https://cdn.example.com/request.js", kind: HttpRequest, pattern: Some("^https:\\/\\/api\\.a\\.test\\/v1\\/post"), conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: true, binary_body: true, full_header: false, max_size: 0, cronexp: "", event: "", timeout: Some(10.0), argument: None }
script.83: ScriptDef { name: "sample.cron", path: "https://cdn.example.com/cron.js", kind: Cron, pattern: None, conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: false, binary_body: false, full_header: false, max_size: 0, cronexp: "0 8 * * *", event: "", timeout: Some(120.0), argument: None }
script.84: ScriptDef { name: "sample.event", path: "https://cdn.example.com/network.js", kind: Event, pattern: None, conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: false, binary_body: false, full_header: false, max_size: 0, cronexp: "", event: "network-changed", timeout: None, argument: None }
script.85: ScriptDef { name: "sample.dns", path: "https://cdn.example.com/dns.js", kind: Dns, pattern: None, conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: false, binary_body: false, full_header: false, max_size: 0, cronexp: "", event: "", timeout: None, argument: None }
script.86: ScriptDef { name: "sample.generic", path: "https://cdn.example.com/generic.js", kind: Generic, pattern: None, conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: false, binary_body: false, full_header: false, max_size: 0, cronexp: "", event: "", timeout: None, argument: None }
script.87: ScriptDef { name: "sample.rule", path: "https://cdn.example.com/rule.js", kind: Rule, pattern: None, conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: false, binary_body: false, full_header: false, max_size: 0, cronexp: "", event: "", timeout: None, argument: None }
